note: Towers: position = centre in metres on the site grid of data/scheme.json (x east, y north), rotation = degrees counter-clockwise in plan (local +y = stair/courtyard side). Podiums: low non-residential blocks between the towers, outline taken from data/scheme.json by id, height in metres. A block may span several scheme cells (schemeIds) and may carry its own label and subtitle. Podium options: roof 'deck' = plain roof without lawn/trees (E3 is one storey); flat = open paved deck over the basement with no building above ground (D4).
